name: Worth Investment & Trading Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Worth Investment and Trading Ltd is registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company[1]
keyPoints:
Business Verticals:[1]
a) Investment Activities:
WITL engages in various investment activities, including acquiring, selling, transferring, subscribing to, and holding shares, bonds, and stocks issued or guaranteed by any company.
b) Financial Assistance:
The company also provides financial assistance through private financing, specifically to identified groups, etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 8.37 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.72% over last 3 years.
